bullets.text: Storm-1175 Targets Vulnerabilities - **Storm-1175** exploits N-days, impacting sectors like healthcare and finance in the **UK**.
AI-Driven Phishing Campaign - An **AI-enabled** phishing campaign uses dynamic code generation to compromise accounts at scale.
AI's Role in Cyberattacks - **AI** is now embedded in cyberattacks, enhancing precision and effectiveness of phishing operations.
Axios NPM Compromise - Malicious **Axios** packages were linked to a North Korean state actor, compromising multiple systems.
WhatsApp Malware Campaign - A new campaign delivers **VBS** payloads via WhatsApp, establishing persistent access on systems.
